text: After this you can choose how to handle unexplained differences during review.
Passing a performance test does not establish every physical detail.
Inferred: An audited controller passes its timing test, but its assembly marking differs from the accepted build record.

items: Ignore the assembly marking because the test passed The test does not establish a match to the accepted build.
Open a build-conformity finding and investigate The difference can now be explained or corrected with evidence.

text: The team has permission to release conditionally while a labeling issue is corrected.

items: Delete the issue from the final report That would hide a condition affecting the release.
Retain the condition and verify the correction The audit record stays accurate until closure is justified.

text: The file does not explain the discrepancy.
Record the unresolved item and the missing evidence.
The disposition is visible and closure has a verification requirement.
An audit conclusion is only as strong as its documented evidence.
Discrepancies need a visible disposition and closure evidence.
